meta.title: Choose an existing event to test Extend Submission Time
gaps: Record the selected event's RFX number in Test Data as a structured test-data value.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Record the selected event's RFX number in Test Data as a structured test-data value.

steps.note: Open the existing events list on the buyer portal.
Verify the list and its Create Event control rendered without an error.
Restrict the selection to live events, excluding history and drafts.
Open the first available live event without inventing an event title.
Verify the selected event shows a Live status badge.
Verify the live event offers the submission-time extension action.
Open the comparison grid to verify that bidding vendors and their bids are present.
Capture the selected event's title and visible RFX number for manual entry into Test Data.
Confirm the selected event screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid values.
